name: Everything Bagel Egg Smash
notes:
Inspired by a classic salmon bagel and everything bagel seasoning: smoked salmon, fresh dill and chives through a creamy egg smash. A good meal-prep lunch.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 9 eggs
• 2 tbsp cream cheese
• 2 tbsp mayonnaise
• 200g smoked salmon
• 1 lemon
• 5g fresh dill
• 5g fresh chives
• 4 tbsp everything bagel seasoning
• Salt
• Black pepper
• 3 bagels

Method:
1. Bring a pan of water to the boil. Once boiling, carefully lower in the eggs and cook for 8 mins. Transfer to a bowl of cold water to cool, then carefully peel off the shells. If you like, separate the yolks from the whites: slice a knife down the side of each white and gently pop the yolk out.
2. Add the eggs to a large bowl with the cream cheese and mayonnaise. Squeeze in the lemon juice. Roughly chop the dill and chives and add those in too. Season with salt and black pepper, then, using a pizza cutter, smash everything together until nicely mashed and mixed.
3. Tear or slice the smoked salmon into pieces and fold it through the smash, then sprinkle in the everything bagel seasoning.
4. To serve, slice a bagel in half for each person, pile a generous dollop of the smash onto the bottom half and sandwich with the top. If you're prepping ahead, keep it in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 2 days.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 9g, fibre 4g, sugars 8g, sodium 2159mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/high-protein-everything-bagel-egg-smash
